summary: A member asks the treasurer to show which money belongs to charity.
realLife: Jon Maines wanted Converse County’s financial statement to identify charitable donations separately so members could see the available balance.
inGame: needs: a committee account, restricted receipts and its current report.

turns.what: The treasurer reads the operating balance from the new column.
turns.pulledBy: The report identifies the restricted receipts.
turns.writesBack: The minutes carry the amount available for committee bills.

turns.what: The member asks which checks it includes.
turns.pulledBy: The report still gives a single total.
turns.writesBack: The spending motion waits for a reconciliation.
